title: CI recognizes earlier PRs contained in later successful target deployments
steps: Run the deterministic delivery reader and dashboard helper tests on the PR branch.
Verify ancestry, both workflow deployments, environment identity and bounded cache warming.
expect: A later successful app and dsh deployment containing the merge commit supersedes an old image failure.
An unrelated commit, another environment, open PR or missing merge SHA cannot establish Live.
Failed, skipped, partial or inaccessible evidence preserves the previous observation.
Old PRs outside bounded history require explicit ancestor comparisons; repeated reads warm remaining PRs without repeating cached evidence.
List and detail share coverage, deployment links and the target deployment completion used by the Live time column.
fence: Only successful target deployment jobs plus commit ancestry establish coverage; ordering and timestamps alone are not proof.

tests: later app and dsh deployments containing the merge commit supersede an old image failure
unrelated ancestry, missing workflow and wrong branch or target keep the original observation
failed, skipped, partial or inaccessible deployment evidence never makes a PR Live
old PRs beyond the history cap become Live only after an explicit ancestor comparison
delivery coverage enriches both list and detail and shares one reader across filter scopes
deployment coverage stays within the PR target environment
bounded comparisons warm remaining old PRs on the next refresh and coalesce identical deployed SHAs
filter timestamps reflect stage events and Live sorting uses the last target deployment completion
